title: Human review record appended per lane review
description: Appended to runs/<runId>/reviews.json by scripts/record-review.mjs. A decision is only valid if boundRevisions exactly match the lane-output artifact hashes the human was shown (approval binds the exact revision).

decidedBy.description: Only humans accept. AI judgments live in qualityChecks, never here.

axisNotes.description: Optional per-axis human comments, kept separate (ux-task / spec-fidelity / accessibility / aesthetic).

feedback.description: Free-form revision direction when decision is revise/rejected.
